values.note: The Forest Service page gives three different prices: 'Single site: $7 per night', '$12.00 daily fee per single site 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes' and '$25.00 per night, Check-in 2:00 PM, Check-out 11:00 AM'. Call the Troy Ranger Station to confirm.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/whitetail-campground (Fee Site and Info: '$12.00 daily fee per single site 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from mid-May through mid-September, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'
12 sites including one host site; gravel roads and parking spurs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/whitetail-campground ('The campground has 12 sites, including one host site, with tables and fire rings. Campground roads and parking spurs are gravel.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water: the description lists 'potable water' but the amenity section says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Pack in, pack out.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/whitetail-campground ('Amenities include potable water, vault toilets', 'Vault toilets', 'Potable water is not available at this site.', 'Please practice Pack-in-Pack-out'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF (Three Rivers Ranger District) campground north of Troy on Yaak Hwy 508, beside the Yaak River, with an undeveloped access for small packable boats. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Apr 30, 2026): confirmed 12 sites (1 host), vault toilets, senior-pass 50% discount.
